rationale: Stage13 qualifies raw IRIS zero-surface reprojection, not final QualifiedMesh G5 product geometry.

The stricter final-mesh precision floor 0.995 rejects the preregistered one-pixel boundary-dilation ACCEPT control at precision 0.987054 and is therefore not transplanted into this earlier raw-geometry gate.
Recall 0.96 and precision 0.94 preserve the already-preregistered IRIS visible-silhouette admission semantics while the frozen G5 anti-hole limits 0.005 are retained unchanged.
component_min_foreground_fraction is zero: every disconnected source-foreground component is eligible, so a small visible accessory cannot be discarded as noise by Stage13.
mutation_rule: After Knight Stage13 result inspection this policy may only be tightened prospectively; it may never be relaxed to convert a failure into PASS.
claim_boundary: Historical policy evidence only. It MUST NOT be used to mint a new Stage13 PASS.
supersession_reason: V1 used 512x512 calibration, treated systematic one-pixel global erosion/dilation as ACCEPT, omitted silhouette-distance admission, and used a coarse candidate grid that jumped from final-mesh 0.995 precision to 0.94.
